description: EKS Auto Mode AZ Impairment - Simulates availability zone failure with pod deletion, network disruption, and node pool AZ exclusion
roleArn: arn:aws:iam::<YOUR AWS ACCOUNT>:role/<YOUR FIS ROLE NAME>

disrupt-az-network.description: Block all network traffic on target AZ subnet via NACLs, simulating full AZ network failure.

cordon-and-exclude-az.description: Cordon nodes, patch NodePool to exclude target AZ, delete pods in target AZ, wait for impairment duration, then restore. All K8s operations are handled by this single SSM automation.
